name: esposter
description: A nice and casual place for posting random things.
author: Jimmy Chen

scripts.bench: vitest bench --run --project scripts && pnpm -r --if-present run bench
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:docs && pnpm build:app
scripts.depcruise:graph: virrun -- depcruise packages/*/src/index.ts --include-only "^packages" --collapse 2 --output-type dot | graphviz -Tsvg > dependency-graph.svg
scripts.lint: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --disable-nested-config && virrun -- eslint . && virrun -- pnpm -r --parallel --aggregate-output run lint
scripts.lint:fix: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --fix --disable-nested-config && virrun -- eslint --fix . && virrun -- pnpm -r --parallel --aggregate-output run lint:fix
scripts.lint:fix:packages: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --fix --disable-nested-config --ignore-pattern "packages/app/**" packages && virrun -- pnpm -r --filter "!@esposter/app" --parallel --aggregate-output run lint:fix
scripts.lint:packages: virrun -- oxlint --format=default --disable-nested-config --ignore-pattern "packages/app/**" packages && virrun -- pnpm -r --filter "!@esposter/app" --parallel --aggregate-output run lint
scripts.release: pnpm build:packages && pnpm lint:fix:packages && pnpm format && pnpm typecheck:packages && lerna publish --yes
scripts.typecheck: virrun -- tsgo && virrun -- pnpm -r --parallel --aggregate-output run typecheck
